title: A bacterial expression cloning screen reveals tardigrade single-stranded DNA-binding proteins as potent desicco-protectants
authors: Jonathan D. Hibshman; Courtney M. Clark-Hachtel; Kerry S. Bloom; Bob Goldstein
one_liner_zh: 该文通过表达克隆筛选发现缓步动物线粒体单链DNA结合蛋白（mtSSB）通过OB折叠域结合ssDNA增强耐干燥性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合活性，但核心是干燥保护机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Tardigrades are known for their ability to survive remarkable extremes, but relatively little is known about the molecular underpinnings that allow for their extraordinary stress tolerance. We devised an expression cloning approach to screen for novel protectants from desiccation-tolerant tardigrades. We expressed cDNA libraries from the tardigrades Hypsibius exemplaris and Ramazzottius varieornatus in E. coli and subjected the bacteria to desiccation. Sequencing the populations of surviving bacteria revealed enrichment of mitochondrial single-stranded DNA-binding proteins (mtSSBs) from both tardigrade species. Expression of mtSSBs in bacteria improved desiccation survival to similar levels as some of the best protectants known to date. The DNA-binding activity of the oligonucleotide/oligosaccharide binding (OB) fold domain of mtSSB was necessary and sufficient to improve desiccation tolerance. By comparing the efficacy of mtSSBs from multiple organisms, we provide evidence that desicco-protection is a conserved feature of mtSSBs. More broadly, any OB-fold containing protein may act similarly to promote desiccation tolerance, likely by coating ssDNA to limit damage during desiccation. These results identify single-stranded DNA-binding activity as a potent contributor to extreme desiccation tolerance.
abstract_zh: 缓步动物以其在极端条件下生存的能力而闻名，但对其非凡胁迫耐受性背后的分子机制知之甚少。我们设计了一种表达克隆方法，用于筛选耐干燥缓步动物中的新型保护因子。我们将来自缓步动物 *Hypsibius exemplaris* 和 *Ramazzottius varieornatus* 的 cDNA 文库在大肠杆菌 (*E. coli*) 中表达，并将细菌置于干燥条件下。对存活细菌群体的测序揭示了来自两种缓步动物的线粒体单链DNA结合蛋白 (mitochondrial single-stranded DNA-binding proteins, mtSSBs) 的富集。在细菌中表达 mtSSBs 将干燥存活率提高至与目前已知的一些最佳保护因子相当的水平。mtSSB 的寡核苷酸/寡糖结合 (oligonucleotide/oligosaccharide binding, OB) 折叠结构域的 DNA 结合活性对于提高干燥耐受性是必要且充分的。通过比较多种生物体中 mtSSBs 的功效，我们提供了证据表明干燥保护是 mtSSBs 的保守特征。更广泛地说，任何含有 OB 折叠的蛋白质都可能以类似方式促进干燥耐受性，可能通过包被单链DNA来减少干燥过程中的损伤。这些结果确定了单链DNA结合活性是极端干燥耐受性的一个强效贡献因素。
